title: Measured curves, fits, agent session transcripts and scripts for an LLM agent taught an XRR fitting procedure
description:
The data behind "Teaching a laboratory LLM agent a tacit procedure: an XRR fitting skill".

Six measured Co/C reflectivity curves, each with its instrument metadata and its raw diffractometer scan; the expert's withheld reference fits of the two qualification curves; the request, state and report files of every fit job of both campaigns, organised by the session names the paper uses; the complete agent session transcripts as cleaned JSONL and as readable Markdown; the written procedure and the prompt each of the eighteen test sessions actually received; the qualification and scoring scripts; and the figures.

The six Ru/C curves and the expert's Ru/C fits are not included. They belong to the companion paper's data deposit and are cited from it rather than duplicated.

Transcript redactions are listed in transcripts/REDACTIONS.md. Checksums for every file are in SHA256SUMS.txt.
